Title: Rules Questions on Lambach Advanced and Path of Death and the Soul

Messages.Author: Mark
Messages.Body:
Is pulling the Eye of Hazimel from my deck as per Advanced Lambach's
ability part of attempting the action, or a consequence of succeeding
at the action? That is, do I get the eye from my deck and throw it in
the ash heap if I'm blocked?

Also, with path of death and the soul, can I tap it to search for a
skill card, fail to find one, and still get a blood for one of my
vamps?

Thanks muchly,
Mark

Messages.Body:

2) Yes

-JTP

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> Can i chose not to get the skill card and only the blood? Even thought
> there are skill cards in my library, hand or ash heap?
>

Yes, you're allowed to fail to find something, even if it's staring you in
the face. Remember, though, that you can put the skill card on *any* of
your minions.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Nikolaj Wendt wrote:
> Can i chose not to get the skill card and only the blood? Even thought
> there are skill cards in my library, hand or ash heap?

You can choose to search your library and then not find anything, even
if there are valid targets in there.
